title: King Abdullah University Hospital (Irbid) — Our Doctors directory + facility pages
publisher: King Abdullah University Hospital (Jordan University of Science and Technology)
notes: 221 practitioners = every doctor on the EN and AR 'Our Doctors' lists (same GUIDs); all EN+AR profile pages and all 'doctors sections' (department) pages fetched. The listing line is free text 'department [subspecialty] | ... | specialty | academic rank | grade', inconsistently filled; specialty = the segment before the rank (EN, AR in extra.specialty_ar), grade mapped from the last segment (Senior Consultant/استشاري أول -> consultant), omitted when EN and AR disagree; title from academic rank (Prof./Assoc. Prof./Asst. Prof.). Raw descriptors kept in extra. EN/AR sometimes disagree (e.g. EN 'Professor|Professor' vs AR 'استاذ|استشاري أول'). Profiles carry only admin position and a CV file link (cv_url, .doc/.pdf not parsed). No schedules, fees or per-doctor phones published. robots.txt is absent (404).
